title: P16-B Strategic ReasoningBrief — deterministic advisory contract
description: P16-B: src/pair/reasoning-brief.ts — ReasoningBriefService.briefFor composes the Strategic ReasoningBrief DETERMINISTICALLY from BrainContextService.contextFor (the ONE read path — owner gate, scope check, read budget, nested-budget refusal and fail-closed strict reads inherited verbatim; RB5/RB9). facts[] carry provenance tiers CANONICAL/PROVEN/PROJECTED/UNVERIFIED + section names — KPI/budget claims PROVEN only when the canonical re-proof ran (RB2/RB2b). hypotheses[] fire only on real canonical signals (RB8: MEASUREMENT_LEADS_EXECUTION requires all-targets-met AND unproven workstreams; resolves when completion proves). options[] enumerate governed candidate moves (CEO_INITIALIZE/PRIORITIZE, OWNER_REVIEW_SIGNOFF, OWNER_RECORD_PROGRESS, OWNER_CONFIGURE/ENABLE_POLICY, WAIT) each naming its existing authority_channel + tradeoff — terminal objectives emit zero options (RB3). missing_information maps unavailable/integrity; expected absences (BINDING_ABSENT, SCOPE_BINDING_ABSENT, *_NOT_WIRED) do not degrade confidence; integrity notes → LOW (RB4). reasoner reuses the canonical model lane: assertCeoModelUsable reported-not-thrown + resolveCeoModelTransport identity — NOT_CONFIGURED/UNRESOLVED/UNQUALIFIED/QUALIFIED, NEVER an invocation (RB7). brief_digest pins canonical content only — asof, actor and clock-volatile gate results excluded (RB1); context_digest binds the exact BrainContext snapshot (P16-C stale-check anchor). ADVISORY_ONLY schema constant; ZERO writes (hash-footprint proof RB6); no second Planner/Router/execution authority. Stacked on P16-A — no CEO wiring yet (P16-C).
